3f3c37d13792ba72.description: Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Commercial is responsible for leading the overall commercial strategy of Sofitel Jabal Omar Makkah, driving sustainable revenue growth, market share, profitability and brand positioning across all business segments. As a key member of the Executive Committee, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, Digital & Communications, Distribution, Reservations and Business Development, ensuring all commercial disciplines operate under one integrated strategy. Working closely with Operations, Finance and Regional Commercial teams, the Director of Commercial develops and executes revenue-generating initiatives that maximize performance across Rooms, Restaurants, Wellness, Meetings & Events and ancillary revenue streams, while strengthening the hotel's position as one of the leading luxury hospitality destinations in Makkah. Acting as both a commercial strategist and brand ambassador, the Director ensures that every commercial initiative reflects the elegance of the Sofitel brand while respecting the cultural and religious significance of the destination. Key Responsibilities, among others; Commercial Strategy & Business Planning: Develop and execute the hotel's overall commercial strategy aligned with business objectives, market conditions and brand standards. Lead the annual commercial planning process including budgeting, forecasting and business plans. Identify new revenue opportunities across all business segments and distribution channels. Establish short, medium and long-term commercial priorities to maximise profitability and market share. Collaborate closely with Operations and Finance to align commercial initiatives with operational capabilities and financial objectives. Monitor market dynamics, competitor activity, demand patterns and industry trends to identify strategic opportunities. Sales Leadership: Lead the Sales function across all market segments including Corporate, Leisure, Wholesale, Government, Luxury Travel, Groups and MICE. Develop strategic sales plans to maximise business from domestic, regional and international markets. Strengthen relationships with key corporate accounts, travel partners, luxury consortia, government entities and tourism stakeholders. Drive proactive business development and account acquisition strategies. Ensure effective sales activities including prospecting, account management, sales missions and client events. Monitor sales performance through defined KPIs and ensure achievement of revenue targets. Revenue Management & Distribution: Provide strategic oversight of Revenue Management to maximise RevPAR, ADR and occupancy. Ensure pricing strategies remain dynamic, competitive and aligned with market demand. Lead weekly commercial and revenue strategy meetings. Optimise channel mix across direct and indirect distribution. Oversee inventory management, segmentation strategies and demand forecasting. Ensure effective management of distribution channels including Brand.com, GDS, OTAs, wholesalers and strategic partners. Continuously identify opportunities to improve profitability through pricing optimisation and revenue management practices. Marketing, Digital & Brand Positioning: Oversee the integrated Marketing, Digital and Communications strategy to strengthen brand awareness, market positioning and commercial performance. Ensure marketing initiatives support revenue objectives across Rooms, F&B, Wellness and ancillary outlets. Champion the hotel's Cultural Link and brand storytelling across all guest touchpoints. Support strategic partnerships, PR initiatives, digital campaigns and luxury brand collaborations. Ensure digital marketing investments generate measurable commercial returns. E-Commerce & Distribution Performance: Drive growth across all digital channels, ensuring strong direct booking performance. Oversee website performance, booking engine optimisation and digital conversion strategies. Support CRM initiatives and guest lifecycle marketing. Monitor digital analytics, campaign performance and customer acquisition costs. Ensure effective collaboration between Revenue, Marketing and Distribution teams. Commercial Performance & Analytics: Monitor commercial performance through key metrics including Revenue, RevPAR, ADR, Occupancy, Market Share, GOP contribution and channel profitability. Analyse market intelligence and competitor performance to support strategic decision-making. Prepare regular commercial performance reports for the General Manager, Executive Committee and Regional Commercial teams. Develop action plans to address business gaps and capitalise on emerging opportunities. Ensure data-driven decision making across all commercial disciplines. Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as a strategic advisor to the General Manager on all commercial matters. Foster strong collaboration between Commercial, Operations, Finance and Talent & Culture. Ensure seamless communication between Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing and Reservations. Drive a culture of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement. Lead commercial projects supporting hotel openings, renovations and strategic initiatives where applicable. Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, coach and develop a high-performing Commercial team. Create an environment that promotes collaboration, innovation and performance excellence. Identify and develop future commercial talent through coaching, mentoring and succession planning. Establish clear objectives and performance expectations across all commercial disciplines. Champion Sofitel's culture, values and luxury service philosophy. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field. Minimum 10 years' experience in commercial leadership within luxury hospitality. Proven experience leading integrated commercial functions including Sales, Revenue Management and Marketing. Strong understanding of luxury hospitality, distribution, pricing strategy and revenue optimisation. Demonstrated ability to deliver sustainable revenue growth and market share improvements. Strong financial and commercial acumen. Excellent analytical and strategic planning skills. Strong leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities. Experience working within an international luxury hotel brand. Fluent in English and Arabic.

3f4535cbaef902e6.job_title: Specialist, Board of Directors Secretariat Affairs

3fe585bfe2a53656.description: Job Title: Chief Specialist, Smart & Efficient Manager and Productive & Safe Worker Reporting To: Director, Technology Development Business Unit / Function: Technology & Innovation Department: Technology Enablement Grade: M13 Why This Role Matters The Chief Specialist, Smart & Efficient Manager and Productive & Safe Worker shapes how technology enables Ma aden s managers and frontline workforce to work more effectively, make better decisions and operate safely. The role provides enterprise technical leadership across two connected domains, translating workforce and operational challenges into scalable technology-enabled solutions. The role creates value by simplifying work, reducing inefficiencies, improving access to timely information and using digital, automation and data capabilities to strengthen workforce productivity and safety. It connects people, process, technology and operational requirements so that solutions address real business needs and can be embedded into day-to-day ways of working. As an enterprise domain authority, the role aligns Operations, HSE, HR, Engineering and Technology teams around shared outcomes, accelerating solutions that improve workforce effectiveness while maintaining safety and operational discipline. What You Will Deliver Workforce Productivity & Manager Effectiveness Shape enterprise strategies and roadmaps for the Smart & Efficient Manager and Productive & Safe Worker domains, aligned with operational priorities and Technology & Innovation objectives. Identify and prioritize opportunities to simplify work, remove process inefficiencies and improve manager and frontline workforce effectiveness. Establish clear value drivers and performance measures that connect technology-enabled interventions to productivity, efficiency and workforce outcomes. Safe & Effective Work Embed safety and risk considerations into the design of workforce technology and operational improvement initiatives. Enable technology solutions that strengthen safe work practices, workforce awareness and risk-based decision-making. Integrate productivity and safety requirements so improvements in workforce efficiency reinforce, rather than compromise, safe operations. Integrated Technology Solutions Translate manager and frontline workforce needs into integrated solutions spanning people, process, data and technology. Shape scalable solutions using relevant digital, automation, analytics and AI capabilities to improve decisions and execution. Ensure solutions are practical for operational environments and designed for effective adoption, integration and scale. Data, Performance & Value Use workforce, operational and safety insights to identify performance gaps and prioritize high-value improvement opportunities. Establish outcome measures, dashboards and value-tracking approaches that demonstrate whether interventions deliver their intended impact. Use performance evidence and user feedback to refine initiatives, improve adoption and strengthen sustained value realization. Enterprise Integration & Capability Align Operations, HSE, HR, Engineering and Technology stakeholders around shared priorities, solution requirements and measurable outcomes. Provide enterprise technical guidance on workforce productivity, manager effectiveness and technology-enabled safe work. Build organizational capability through knowledge transfer, reusable solutions and adoption of proven practices across appropriate operations. What Success Looks Like Managers and frontline workers spend less time on avoidable, inefficient or fragmented activities and more time on value-adding work. Technology-enabled interventions deliver measurable improvements in workforce productivity, operational efficiency or decision effectiveness. Workforce solutions strengthen safe work and risk awareness while meeting operational requirements. High-value solutions achieve sustained adoption and can be replicated or scaled across applicable operations. Managers and frontline teams have improved access to relevant information and insights for timely decision-making. Business, HSE, HR and Technology stakeholders align around common workforce outcomes, priorities and value measures. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management or a related discipline. Experience 15+ years of relevant experience across operations, operational transformation, productivity improvement, safety or technology-enabled business improvement. Significant experience in industrial, mining or comparable asset-intensive operating environments. Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale transformation, operational excellence or workforce improvement initiatives. Experience applying digital, data, automation or continuous-improvement approaches to workforce productivity or safety challenges. Skills That Matter Workforce productivity and operational excellence Manager and frontline work optimization Safety and operational risk integration Digital, automation and AI-enabled improvement Data-driven performance and value realization Integrated solution design and deployment Continuous improvement and process optimization Enterprise stakeholder influence Change, adoption and capability building Cross-functional integration and facilitation

3fb1ad3f57688ca5.description: Lead Learning & Development initiatives across the Holding Company and its subsidiaries, aligning learning strategies with business objectives and operational needs. Drive employee capability development, succession planning, and high-potential talent development while overseeing training programs, external providers, and the Learning Management System (LMS) to enhance workforce performance and organizational effectiveness. Develop and implement the Group-wide Learning & Development strategy and annual training plan in alignment with business objectives and subsidiary requirements. Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA) in collaboration with HR and business leaders to identify competency gaps and prioritize learning initiatives. Design and coordinate learning solutions for corporate, sales, aftersales, service, and technical teams, including leadership, digital learning, and professional development programs. Support succession planning by identifying critical positions, assessing successor readiness, and developing Individual Development Plans (IDPs) for successors and high-potential employees. Manage external training providers and consultants, including evaluating proposals, negotiating services and costs, and ensuring training quality and value for money. Oversee the LMS, ensuring effective utilization, up-to-date learning content, accurate training records, and monitoring of training completion. Coordinate mandatory training, including Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) and Code of Conduct, with relevant departments and monitor compliance across the Group. Manage the training budget and evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, participant feedback, workplace application, and relevant performance indicators. Prepare regular reports on training delivery, competency development, talent initiatives, budget utilization, and learning outcomes. Promote continuous learning through coaching, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and blended learning initiatives across the Holding Company and its subsidiaries. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Education, Organizational Development, or a related field; relevant professional certifications such as CIPD or CPTD are an advantage. Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in Learning & Development, Training, or Talent Development. Experience managing training and development initiatives across a holding company, group of companies, or multiple business units. Proven experience in TNA, annual training planning, succession planning, and high-potential talent development. Hands-on experience managing an LMS, external training providers, and training budgets. Required Skills and Competencies Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both Arabic and English. Strong persuasion, negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, particularly when dealing with external training providers. Strong knowledge of training needs analysis, learning principles, training methodologies, and learning evaluation. Ability to develop talent, support succession planning, and translate business needs into practical learning solutions. Proficiency in LMS platforms, learning analytics, reporting, and training effectiveness evaluation. Strong planning, project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across different companies and departments. Key Performance Indicators Annual Training Plan Delivery: Percentage of planned training programs completed within the approved timeframe and budget. Training Effectiveness: Measurable improvement in targeted employee competencies and application of learning in the workplace. Succession Planning Coverage: Percentage of identified critical positions with documented succession plans and development actions. High-Potential Talent Development: Progress against approved development plans for identified high-potential employees. Mandatory Training Compliance: Percentage of employees completing assigned HSE and other mandatory training within the required timeframe. LMS Performance: Accuracy of learning records and timely reporting of training completion. Training Provider Performance: Provider quality, stakeholder satisfaction, and cost-effectiveness. Stakeholder Satisfaction: Feedback from employees, managers, and business leaders on the relevance and effectiveness of L&D initiatives.

3fa087ac74851923.description: About MEMF Electrical Industries Co. MEMF Electrical Industries Co., the industrial arm of KFB Holding Group, supports Saudi Arabia’s power infrastructure by providing locally engineered and high-quality electrical products. The company operates advanced manufacturing facilities in Riyadh, producing a wide range of solutions for utility and industrial customers. These products are internationally type-tested and supported by engineering expertise and certified quality systems (ISO 9001 & ISO 45001). Role Summary MEMF Electrical Industries Co. is seeking a Facility Maintenance Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves planning, coordinating, and supervising maintenance activities for various facility systems. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in facility maintenance. Key Responsibilities Plan, coordinate, and supervise preventive and corrective maintenance for electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and building systems. Conduct regular facility inspections, identify maintenance requirements, and prioritize work orders based on urgency and operational needs. Supervise maintenance technicians, allocate tasks, and ensure work adheres to quality and safety standards. Coordinate with contractors and service providers to ensure work delivery according to agreed specifications, schedules, and safety requirements. Monitor the condition and performance of facility equipment, recommending necessary repairs, replacements, and upgrades. Oversee the maintenance of fire protection and emergency systems through qualified service providers. Prepare maintenance budgets, monitor expenditures, and evaluate quotations, spare parts, and resource requirements. Maintain preventive maintenance schedules, equipment records, service reports, and work order documentation. Ensure compliance with safety procedures, permit-to-work requirements, and equipment isolation protocols. Support facility renovation, installation, and improvement projects. Monitor utility consumption and identify opportunities for energy and water efficiency improvements. Prepare periodic reports on maintenance performance, system downtime, outstanding issues, and corrective actions. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in facility maintenance. What We Offer A professional and collaborative working environment. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. A competitive compensation package commensurate with qualifications and experience.

3f55302470bba088.description: Job description Field Service Representative (Sonar Systems) Location Jeddah, Saudi Arabia Contract Type Fixed-Term Contract (2 Years) Reporting To Project Manager Overview We are seeking an experienced Field Service Representative (FSR) to provide on-site technical support and maintenance expertise for advanced naval sonar systems operating within a maritime defence environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the operational readiness, reliability, and performance of towed sonar equipment through preventive and corrective maintenance activities, technical diagnostics, engineering support, and stakeholder engagement. This position is based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with occasional travel or deployment requirements based on operational needs. Key Responsibilities Technical Diagnostics & Troubleshooting Conduct in-depth fault diagnosis and root-cause analysis of complex sonar system issues. Utilise diagnostic software, test equipment, and maintenance documentation to identify and resolve technical problems efficiently. Provide technical recommendations and support for system performance improvements. Preventive Maintenance Execute planned preventive maintenance activities to maximise equipment availability and operational readiness. Ensure maintenance activities are completed in accordance with approved maintenance schedules and technical procedures. Support lifecycle management initiatives to extend equipment service life. Corrective Maintenance & Repair Perform corrective maintenance activities, including component replacement, repair, testing, and recommissioning of sonar equipment. Restore systems to full operational capability while maintaining compliance with technical and safety standards. Escalate complex technical issues when specialist engineering support is required. Engineering Support Assist with the development and execution of annual engineering support plans. Support technical investigations, reliability assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with engineering teams to address recurring system performance issues. Documentation & Reporting Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, system defects, repairs, and technical interventions. Produce regular maintenance reports and technical updates for management and customer stakeholders. Ensure all documentation remains current and aligned with quality management requirements. Inventory & Spare Parts Management Support the management and control of maintenance inventory and spare parts. Track parts consumption and maintain accurate inventory records. Identify critical spare requirements and support replenishment planning. Compliance, Quality & Safety Ensure all maintenance activities are performed in accordance with company procedures, quality standards, and safety regulations. Promote a strong safety culture and adhere to all site-specific health, safety, and environmental requirements. Support audits, inspections, and compliance reviews where required. Stakeholder Engagement Act as a key technical interface between operational personnel, engineering teams, and maintenance management. Build effective working relationships within a multicultural and multidisciplinary environment. Deliver professional technical support while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. Skills & Experience Essential Strong theoretical and practical knowledge of sonar systems, particularly towed-array or variable-depth sonar technologies. Hands-on experience in troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and testing of sonar equipment and associated subsystems. Proficiency using diagnostic software, calibration tools, and electronic test equipment. Experience supporting complex defence, naval, maritime, or mission-critical systems. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities. Desirable Previous experience supporting naval sonar operations in an operational or military environment. Knowledge of broader Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) and through-life support activities. Experience working with multinational teams and customer-facing support environments. Former military technical or naval engineering experience would be advantageous. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

3fe0f59d037b063c.description: Summary The Brand Manager is responsible for managing the Company Portfolio of brands, ensuring the effectiveness of day to day marketing activities as well as the implementation of the long term marketing strategy of the company. Managing the innovation product pipeline & associated activities are also core pillars of the job. Resposibilities Assist the Marketing Manager, in executing Company’s strategic goals, objectives, guidelines, plans, and budgets to enhance Company’s market share & exposure in markets. Review the performance of the marketing department vs the annual plan and report progress to the MM, suggest a corrective action plan where required. Responsible for periodical analysis of the competition and reporting any significant activities including launches, promotions & activations. Assist MM, the innovation pipeline from idea conception to delivery, through managing the cross functional team consisting of Finance, Supply Chain, R&D & Marketing. Brief research agencies (when required) in an adhoc research for mix validation & testing as part of the innovation process. This includes: The testing of the following components of the marketing mix (product, price, promotion, proposition & packaging). The selection & qualification of all research agencies & signing off research design ahead of fieldwork in alignment with the MM. Manage all aspects of the creative process including the management of the creative agency. This includes briefing the communication agency ensuring that they are clear on the communication objectives. The Brand Manager needs to ensure that the creative elements of the campaign are produces in line with agreed budgets and brand guidelines. Develop social media platforms & assign & manage social media agencies in order to ensure that brand targets achieved. Manage the media agency in terms of media bookings, selecting the appropriate channels for the Target Group depending on the respective media type. Overseeing the development in collaboration with a BTL agency of all aspects of activation in order to bring the brands to life on the ground. Review and approve all marketing collateral including packaging designs in order to ensure they are in line with brand guidelines. Ensure the delivery of the Brand Financial Targets by working closely with the sales team, ensuring that all marketing assets are delivered on time in full, in order to enable brand growth. Implement the brand promotion strategy & cascade to the relevant sales team to ensure brands performance in market. Ensure the implementation of the agreed marketing calendar in respective markets. Conduct a brand audit on annual basis, in order to identify issues & opportunity as input into developing a Brand Marketing Plan, & annual objective & KPIs with the approval of the MM. Manage the volume & value forecasting on a 6 month plus window to ensure product availability in markets in line with aligned volume targets. Report the monthly budget utilization to ensure financial targets are being met. Conduct periodical market share analysis & report findings to the MM. Suggesting corrective measures where required. Visits to key markets (periodically) to conduct an environmental scan on competitive activates & identify consumer trends, and report back to the MM where applicable. Review (Quarterly) all competitor media activities with key highlights being shared with the MM. Supervise the daily activities of the Assistant Brand Manager Managerial Manage the team ensuring sufficient time spent in coaching to develop the talent within the organization. Manage the development of the team work plans ensuring clarity on annual job objectives & deliverables. Conduct annual performance review in line with the company appraisal process, including finalizing performance rating & suggesting pay increments & bonus levels where applicable. 3f0520e875798282.description: About the Role The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, *** is seeking a Sales Executive to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Resolve guest calls, requests, or problems by contacting appropriate departments such as Sales, Data Administration, or Accounting. Utilize sales techniques to maximize revenue, including up-selling, while maintaining guest loyalty to Marriott. Determine and offer complimentaries to guests as gifts for their patronage, such as rewards points, show tickets, or gift certificates. Promote awareness of the brand image both internally and externally. Process requests for redeeming Marriott Rewards points and enter Marriott Rewards information into the relevant software during reservations. Handle all reservation requests, changes, and cancellations received via phone, fax, or mail. Answer, record, and process all guest calls, requests, questions, or concerns. Team Collaboration and Standards Assist management in training and motivating employees, serving as a role model. Adhere to all company policies and procedures, ensuring a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address service needs, and express genuine appreciation. 3f092d9a4b50a652.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اثر التميز للمقاولات عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة تنفيذ أعمال المسح الاستطلاعي والتسوية المساحية لمشاريع الأبنية والطرق وغيرها، بالإضافة إلى رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية اللازمة للمشاريع الإنشائية المختلفة، وإعداد مسودات بالمنشآت والعوائق والقنوات والطرق الفرعية. تحديد نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط وتثبيتها، واختيار أنواع الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية اللازمة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية المختلفة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية من المخططات على الأرض. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات، وتثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها، وتوقيع المنحنيات المختلفة بحسب المخططات. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية والمنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة المختلفة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المساحة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية المساحية. مهارة في رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المساحة ضمن فريق شركة اثر التميز للمقاولات في المدينة المنورة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مواقع المشاريع حسب الحاجة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلب التوظيف عبر القنوات المتاحة.

3f17959c37e53cba.description: About LIXIL and GROHE LIXIL, a publicly listed company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, includes GROHE, a global brand and leading provider of sanitary fittings. GROHE is dedicated to innovative water products, upholding brand values of technology, quality, design, and sustainability. With engineering, innovation, and design activities based in Germany, GROHE products carry the "Made in Germany" quality badge. Role Overview LIXIL is seeking a Project Sales Manager for the Western Region. This employee role is focused on driving profitable sales growth within the market across all channels, aligning with GROHE’s mission. The primary objective is to achieve annual sales targets, increase market share within the sector, and enhance GROHE's geographical presence in the country. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Primary Responsibilities Contribute to the overall delivery of country results and organizational leadership. Participate in strategic planning for channel development. Deliver on the Sales Mission in line with corporate objectives and KPIs. Deliver on the Project Channel Sales Mission assigned for the country’s market, aligning with corporate objectives and KPIs. Manage projects, including writing and maintaining project specifications within the Grohe project system. Align regularly with the Line Manager on mid and long-term strategies for the country, ensuring local implementation complies with corporate guidelines. Provide high-quality information and analysis to support strategic priorities and initiatives. Identify key channels and targets in the region for project business. Forecast accurate project sales on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis. Maintain professional relationships with designers and architects in the country.
